describe: The image shows a sniper rifle's metal parts laid out as a texture: a grey-teal painted metal body on the left with a glossy pale grey rim, a dark recess with a red sight dot and a red bar at the left edge, two round silver-grey dials at the centre and a larger round dial below, a red circle at the bottom centre, and an orange-brown ribbed panel on the right. Lighting is soft, with darker shadows at the lower left. It looks like a UV texture sheet, so keep every piece in place.
